name: Alfven-wave collision
blurb: Two Alfven waves travelling in opposite directions along a guide field, polarized across each other: their collision is the building block of MHD turbulence (Howes & Nielson 2013). It passes energy to waves of shorter wavelength across the field, but not along it. The setup follows the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html).
